```yaml
name: Performance Regressions

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
    paths:
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/**'
      - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  benchmark-rust:
    name: Benchmark Rust Core (Keyboard & Rendering)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install hyperfine
        run: cargo install hyperfine

      - name: Run Keyboard Serialization Benchmarks
        run: |
          # Benchmark the new keyboard event grouping and serialization logic
          cd crates/project
          cargo bench --bench keyboard_bench -- --output-format bencher > keyboard_bench_results.txt
          
          # Extract mean time for comparison (simplified for this example)
          # In a real scenario, you would use a tool like 'cargo bench' with baseline comparison
          # or store results in an artifact and compare in a separate job.
          cat keyboard_bench_results.txt

      - name: Run Rendering Pipeline Benchmarks
        run: |
          cd crates/rendering
          cargo bench --bench keyboard_render_bench -- --output-format bencher > render_bench_results.txt
          cat render_bench_results.txt

      - name: Upload Benchmark Results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rust-benchmark-results
          path: |
            crates/project/keyboard_bench_results.txt
            crates/rendering/render_bench_results.txt

  benchmark-typescript:
    name: Benchmark TypeScript Editor Components
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: apps/desktop/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npm ci

      - name: Run Component Render Benchmarks
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          # Assuming a benchmark script exists in package.json or using a library like react-benchmark
          # This step simulates checking for performance regressions in the new Timeline Tracks
          npm run benchmark:components || echo "No component benchmarks defined, skipping."

      - name: Check Bundle Size (KeyboardTab & Tracks)
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npm run build
          # Analyze bundle size for the new features
          npx source-map-explorer build/**/*.js --html > bundle-analysis.html || true
          ls -lh build/

      - name: Upload Bundle Analysis
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ts-bundle-analysis
          path: apps/desktop/bundle-analysis.html

  check-performance-regressions:
    name: Check for Regressions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [benchmark-rust, benchmark-typescript]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Download Rust Benchmarks
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rust-benchmark-results
          path: rust-benchmarks

      - name: Download TS Bundle Analysis
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ts-bundle-analysis
          path: ts-benchmarks

      - name: Compare Results (Placeholder)
        run: |
          echo "Reviewing benchmark results..."
          cat rust-benchmarks/keyboard_bench_results.txt || true
          cat rust-benchmarks/render_bench_results.txt || true
          
          # In a production setup, you would compare these against a baseline stored in GitHub Pages or S3
          # and fail the job if the regression exceeds a threshold (e.g., 10%)
          
          echo "No automated regression threshold configured. Please review artifacts manually."

      - name: Comment on PR if Regressions Detected
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: '⚠️ **Performance Regression Detected**\n\nThe performance benchmarks for the new Keyboard and Captions tracks have shown potential regressions. Please review the benchmark artifacts attached to this workflow run.\n\n- Rust Benchmarks: `rust-benchmark-results`\n- TS Bundle Analysis: `ts-bundle-analysis`'
            })
```
